main_body: grass ground patch with small flowers
evidence: This is a flat ground terrain patch (2x1 tiles of grass with tufts and flowers), which appropriately shows only the horizontal top surface across all 16 rows.

style.evidence: The grass uses 4 green shades plus 2-step pink and yellow flowers, with darker green shading under tufts. However, the background green has noticeable flat patches (up to 4x4-5x4 px) lacking the fine subtle dither/grain of the Beodeul grass reference, and the 4-pixel cross flowers are somewhat blocky compared to the reference's finer flower dots.
